turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
I didn't come to be thanked. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that mark, and who decided on a zero?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. You haven't answered my question: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, and who decided?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why are we here? I've asked you twice about the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
"Teammates." Okay. Teammates don't enter a zero first and call home never, so tell me what you actually have, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
